metadata.name: defn.commit
metadata.description: Definition-commit channel. Binder formulas (compiler call + name literal) enqueue here; the drain owns creation, redefinition, rename retirement, and the orphan sweep.

metadata.name: defn.drain
metadata.description: (items) - commit binder requests: setCel EditableLambdaCels (definedBy/origin stamped), enforce ownership + overwrite flag, retire renames and orphans (binders are authoritative for a name's existence).
